title: Disable network throttling
description: Remove the multimedia network throttling limit.
danger: Without the limit, background network tasks can compete with games and calls, and the gains are often too small to measure. Easy to revert.
why: Windows throttles non-multimedia network traffic while media is playing (default 10 packets/ms). Disabling it can help latency-sensitive use, but gains are small and not guaranteed.

title: Disable update sharing
description: Stop uploading Windows updates to other PCs.
why: Delivery Optimization can use your connection to send update files to other PCs. Mode 0 downloads updates from Microsoft only; updates still work normally.
